summary: Frontend-only test of the Dark Mode text visibility fix on the Iron Rabbit Notes PWA. Verified via page.evaluate(getComputedStyle) that in DARK mode all text/input `color` and `-webkit-text-fill-color` resolve to light values (rgb(248, 250, 252) = hsl(210 40% 98%)) across NoteModal, FullScreenNote, AccordionNoteItem, Settings modal, Language picker, and placeholders. In LIGHT mode the same fields resolve to a dark value (rgb(15, 23, 41)). Root `color-scheme: dark` and body.nx-light `color-scheme: light` are correctly applied. The dark-on-dark bug reported by the user is fixed. Zero console/page errors.
passed_tests: Dark mode NoteModal: title input + content textarea render text in rgb(248,250,252) via -webkit-text-fill-color safety net (index.css L192-197 rule verified applied).
Dark mode placeholders show muted-light rgb(148,163,184) via ::placeholder rule.
Dark mode FullScreenNote: title + content inputs both light; visual screenshot confirms readable white-on-dark rendering.

Dark mode AccordionNoteItem: category and note titles render in light color; screenshot shows 'Test notes', 'Test', 'TEST DarkNote', 'Test Reminder Note', 'Test Note' all clearly readable on the dark background.

Dark mode Settings modal: labels (rgb 148,163,184 muted-foreground), inputs (rgb 248,250,252 fill) — 'Language', 'Security & Privacy', 'Company Name', 'Logo', 'Header Background', 'Website URL', 'Backup & Restore', 'Storage Used', 'Clear All Data' all visible in screenshot.
Dark mode Language picker modal: search input renders light text.
Light mode NoteModal: title input renders in rgb(15,23,41) — dark text on light bg confirmed.
Light mode Settings modal: input renders in rgb(15,23,41) with 7 inputs found — all dark-on-light.
Theme toggle: clicking Sun/Moon button flips body.nx-light class immediately; root/body `color-scheme` CSS property changes from 'dark' -> 'light' and back. No stale styling.
meta color-scheme in index.html + CSS :root color-scheme rules applied — fix for iOS Safari native input coloring is in place.
Zero console errors, zero page errors across the entire dark/light toggling flow.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css L192-204 defensive rules (color + -webkit-text-fill-color + caret-color + placeholder overrides) are the correct fix for iOS Safari/WebView forcing dark text on native form controls. Confirmed applied via getComputedStyle.
index.css L177-178 declares `:root { color-scheme: dark }` and `body.nx-light { color-scheme: light }` — verified switching in playwright reflects immediately.
index.css L216-220 ::selection override includes -webkit-text-fill-color; good coverage.
index.css L224-229 attribute-selector override for inline style='color: #000' is a nice belt-and-suspenders defense against legacy inline styles.

Minor observation: the placeholder color in NoteModal computed as rgb(71, 85, 105) for `color` but rgb(148, 163, 184) for -webkit-text-fill-color. Both are light-ish; on iOS Safari the -webkit- one wins. Good.
NotesApp.jsx L104-107 toggles `nx-light` class on document.body based on isDark state, with cleanup — correct pattern.
No hardcoded dark text colors were found in inputs; all conditionals use isDark ternaries. The CSS safety net covers any remaining edge cases.

rca of the issue: N/A — bug is fixed. Original RCA (from main agent): iOS Safari + some Android WebViews force native form-control text color when the page doesn't declare `color-scheme`, causing dark text inside dark-themed inputs regardless of Tailwind text-white classes. Fix: (1) meta color-scheme in index.html, (2) :root and body.nx-light color-scheme in CSS, (3) input/textarea/[contenteditable] rules setting color + -webkit-text-fill-color + caret-color to hsl(var(--foreground)), (4) ::placeholder + ::selection + :-webkit-autofill overrides. All confirmed applied via getComputedStyle.
